name: Resistor Environment QA 12
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Potential difference within a loop using Kirchhoff's Loop Rule

examples.input: A circuit with 12V and 3V batteries and resistances \SI{1}{\ohm}, \SI{2}{\ohm} forms a loop in the following order if we start from Point A in clockwise. Point A , \SI{2}{\ohm}, 12V , \SI{1}{\ohm}, \SI{2}{\ohm}, Point B , \SI{3}{\ohm}, 3V, \SI{1}{\ohm}. To find VA - VB, which approach is most systematic?
